from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from drf_yasg.generators import OpenAPISchemaGenerator
from drf_yasg import openapi
from .models import WhiteLabelClient

class ClientOpenAPISpecExportView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, client_uuid):
        client = WhiteLabelClient.objects.get(uuid=client_uuid)
        # Ensure the requesting user is an administrator of the requested white-label client
        if request.user.client_id != client.id:
            raise PermissionDenied('Access denied to OpenAPI specifications of external clients')

        info = openapi.Info(title=client.brand_name, default_version='v2')
        generator = OpenAPISchemaGenerator(info=info, urlconf=client.endpoints_urlconf)
        schema = generator.get_schema(request=request._request, public=False)
        return Response(schema)
